
A '''gismu''' consists either of an [[Morphology: consonants|initial-pair]], a [[Morphology: vowels|stressed-vowel]], and a [[Morphology: syllables|final-syllable]] composed of [[Morphology: consonants|consonant]] [[Morphology: vowels owel]] (CCVCV), or of a [[Morphology: consonants|consonant]], a [[Morphology: vowels|stressed-vowel]], a [[Morphology: consonants|consonant]], and a [[Morphology: syllables|final-syllable]] composed of [[Morphology: consonants|consonant]] [[Morphology: vowels owel]] (CVC/CV).
